benchmark.limits: Three alternating samples on a shared x86_64 development host; identical guest ELF, full musl and cloned app stores. Allocator routing is off except allocator-native. Runtime seconds exclude import; Vim seconds measure spawn to first normal cursor visibility. Worker CPU/body sums overlap host wall/checkpoint waits. Native copy: four threads, 512 copies of 1 MiB each, 2 GiB total. Counters: four disjoint counters in one page, 400000 increments each. No timing assertions or iPad performance claim.
